_doc: PHASE 2B.2 pivot manifest + per-part scale for the Warlock cutout rig. pivot = [x,y] NORMALIZED (0-1) in the ingested assets/sprites/<part>.png (Phaser setOrigin); it is the JOINT the part rotates around. worldH = the part's intended TOTAL height as a fraction of the warlock's figure height (reference landmarks: shoulders 0.19, belt 0.40); alphaH = opaque px height; buildWarlockRig applies scale = nominalH*worldH/alphaH. v5 (2026-07-06): the GREEN-LIT batch — robe/torso/head/staff generated from Hiro's approved full-body edit (console-confirmed ref=ref_warlock_greenlit.png), arm_staff_fore from the idle ref. Head now includes its own ornate collar below the neck pivot (drawn after torso_body, so it overlaps the torso's neck sliver = hidden seam); torso belt low in frame (~0.75); robe waist band at the very top of its frame.

warlock_part_head.joint: neck base (collar below pivot overlaps torso)

warlock_part_robe_lower.joint: waist/belt (band tucks UNDER the torso belt)
